finish_summary: 1. bulk_discount_percent(50) returns 5 instead of expected 10 (threshold logic wrong). 2. parse_coupon rejects valid coupons with mixed case or surrounding whitespace; should be case‑insensitive and strip spaces. 3. Cart.remove_item leaves entry with quantity 0 in items(); implementation fails to delete item when quantity reaches zero. 4. Subtotal for 10 apples + 40 bananas computed as 85.5 instead of 89.5 (bulk discount or rounding mis‑applied). 5. Cart.total(member=True, coupon="SAVE20") returns 800 instead of expected 830 (shipping fee or coupon discount applied incorrectly).
